_note: Phase 4 analysis plan, fixed on 2026-11-15 BEFORE any cascade, ensemble or random-deferral result was computed. Do not edit after the dev analysis has run; record any change in PROGRESS.md with the reason.
join_key: idx; ids, labels and datasets must be identical across models or the script stops

cascade.defer_rule: defer the claim to Flan-T5 if |p_roberta - 0.5| < delta; otherwise keep RoBERTa's prediction
cascade.final_prediction: prediction of the model that made the decision, at the paper's threshold 0.5 (no threshold tuning)

delta_grid.note: delta = 0 is RoBERTa alone; the largest delta defers every claim, i.e. Flan-T5 alone

cascade.thresholds_global: one delta for all datasets (the dataset is unknown at deployment time)

selection_on_dev.primary: the smallest delta (lowest simulated dev cost) whose dev macro BAcc >= Flan-T5's dev macro BAcc
selection_on_dev.primary_if_none: if no delta reaches Flan-T5's dev BAcc, the delta with the highest dev macro BAcc (ties: smaller delta); reported as a negative result
selection_on_dev.secondary: the delta with the highest dev macro BAcc (ties: smaller delta); reported, but not the headline result
selection_on_dev.frozen_file: results/phase4/selected_thresholds.json; the test evaluation reads delta only from this file

ensemble.rule: majority vote of the three models' predictions (each at threshold 0.5); no weights, nothing tuned
ensemble.cost: sum of the three models' measured latencies (run one after another on one GPU)

random_deferral_control.rule: defer randomly chosen claims, with the same number of deferred claims per dataset as the cascade

oracle_reference: defer exactly the claims RoBERTa gets wrong and Flan-T5 gets right (upper bound for any RoBERTa->Flan-T5 deferral rule; reference only)

cost_model.per_claim_ms: latency_roberta + (latency_flan if deferred), using the measured per-claim latency_ms of each model on the T4
cost_model.excluded: model loading (reported separately) and the 5 OOM-retry delays (2.5 s in total), as in the Phase 3 baselines
cost_model.label: simulated from separately measured latencies; not an end-to-end measurement

statistics.bootstrap: paired, claims resampled within each dataset, macro BAcc recomputed per replicate

success_criteria_on_test.outcome_1_better_than_flan: lower bound of the 95% CI of (cascade - Flan-T5) macro BAcc > 0
success_criteria_on_test.outcome_2_comparable_and_faster: lower bound of the 95% CI of (cascade - Flan-T5) > -0.5 BAcc points AND simulated total inference time <= 0.8 x Flan-T5's (speed-up >= 1.25x)
